content: The extensive data collected through continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) enables a more thorough and detailed analysis of diabetes management by allowing the tracking of glucose level trends over time. Proper utilization of CGM data can lead to improved clinical outcomes by offering precise insights into patterns of hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia. Recent guidelines highlight the critical importance of adopting standardized methods for interpreting CGM data to facilitate timely clinical decision-making and necessary adjustments in treatment plans.
